full_track.tags: K-Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, jazzy chord progression with light chorus and reverb. A warm electric bass follows the guitar's root notes with occasional melodic fills. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a soft kick drum playing a steady backbeat. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational baritone with light doubling in the chorus. The tempo is 88 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar strumming and the vocal melody.
